description: This file contains the implementation of low-level resource reading, writing, filtering, and pipeline processing for Kubernetes resource configuration management within the kio package. It defines interfaces, structs, and functions for handling resource nodes, filters, and pipelines, including internal annotation reconciliation.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: Interface for reading resource nodes, similar to io.Reader.

classes.name: ResourceNodeSlice
classes.description: Slice of resource nodes implementing the Reader interface.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: Interface for writing resource nodes, similar to io.Writer.

classes.name: WriterFunc
classes.description: Function type implementing the Writer interface.

classes.name: ReaderWriter
classes.description: Combines both Reader and Writer interfaces.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Interface for modifying a collection of resource nodes.

classes.name: TrackableFilter
classes.description: Extension of Filter that can track mutations.

classes.name: FilterFunc
classes.description: Function type implementing the Filter interface.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Struct representing a resource processing pipeline with inputs, filters, and outputs.

classes.name: PipelineExecuteCallbackFunc
classes.description: Callback function invoked after each successful pipeline step.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads resource nodes from the ResourceNodeSlice.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes resource nodes using the provided Writer.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters resource nodes, modifying and returning the collection.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Implementation of Filter interface as a function.

methods.name: ExecuteWithCallback
methods.description: Executes the pipeline with a callback after each step.

methods.name: FilterAll
methods.description: Runs a yaml.Filter against all input nodes.

methods.name: PreprocessResourcesForInternalAnnotationMigration
methods.description: Prepares resource nodes for internal annotation migration, returning a mapping.

methods.name: checkMismatchedAnnos
methods.description: Checks for mismatched internal and legacy annotations.

methods.name: ReconcileInternalAnnotations
methods.description: Reconciles annotation formats for resource nodes.

methods.name: determineAnnotationsFormat
methods.description: Determines if resources use internal, legacy, or both annotation formats.

methods.name: missingInternalOrLegacyAnnotations
methods.description: Ensures resource nodes have both internal and legacy annotations.

methods.name: missingInternalOrLegacyAnnotation
methods.description: Ensures a specific annotation key is present, copying from legacy if needed.

methods.name: checkAnnotationsAltered
methods.description: Checks if annotations have been altered and reconciles them.

methods.name: formatInternalAnnotations
methods.description: Formats resource node annotations based on internal/legacy usage.
